etiquette: Please arrive 10 minutes early to enjoy the foot soak.
Tell us about pregnancy, injuries or medical conditions when you book.
Phones on silent: the spa is a quiet place.
Changing your time? Let us know at least 3 hours ahead.

items.a: We recommend it, especially in the evening and at weekends. Walk-ins are welcome when a therapist is free.

items.q: Can I choose a male or female therapist?
items.a: Yes, tell us when you book and we arrange it whenever possible.

items.q: Are your treatments suitable during pregnancy?
items.a: Some are, after the first trimester and with adapted techniques. Please tell us when you book so we can suggest the right one.
Natural oils and herbs: lemongrass, ginger, coconut, turmeric, aloe. Tell us about any allergies.
Yes, for any treatment or package. Call or message us on Zalo to order one.
